title: Size bound for unfolded circuits
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, whose gates have distinct argument vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Suppose every gate has at most $k$ arguments. For every fuel bound, polarity, and vertex $v<n+|C.	ext{gates}|$ with $v$ less than the fuel bound, the unfolded tree at $v$ has size at most $(k+1)^{d(v)}$, where $d(v)$ is the depth assigned to vertex $v$ in $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is well formed: each gate has distinct argument vertices and every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most $k$ arguments
$v$ is less than the fuel bound
